name: Witch Hunter: attacks against a Torchlight target grant Flames of Sin
contract: Torchlight 503662 reads 'Throw a torch at an enemy, dealing ... Fire damage, and causing up to $N of the next
attacks you make against them to grant you Flames of Sin and increasing the duration by
$/1000;504779s2 sec.' Effect 0 is a dummy aura on the enemy (TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY, 5 proc charges) naming
504779, whose effects grant Flames of Sin 803422 to the caster and extend it by 1999 + 1 = 2000 ms. So the
hunter's first auto attack against the marked enemy must give the hunter Flames of Sin, and its auto attacks
are then followed by Flames of Sin Fire hits 802850. The mark's owner is the enemy, which must not gain Flames
of Sin itself. spell_ascension_witch_hunter_torchlight_mark casts 504779 from the hunter for the hunter's own
attacks, but its Load read GetTarget(), which is null outside effect hooks (AuraScript::GetTarget), so the
script never attached: the native dummy proc made the marked enemy cast 504779 on itself for any attacker, and
the hunter never gained Flames of Sin. The fixture dual-wields, so its swings are at most 1.6 s apart and each
one lands inside the 2 s the previous grant or extension left. Ratings remove melee misses, dodges and parries.

steps.label: SETUP: the off hand holds a weapon
Control: auto attacks without the mark grant no Flames of Sin
DISCRIMINATING: an auto attack against the marked enemy grants Flames of Sin
Auto attacks under the granted Flames of Sin are followed by its Fire hits
The marked enemy does not gain Flames of Sin itself
